stock.description: Mobvoi Inc., an investment holding company, distributes smart devices and various accessories across numerous international markets, including Mainland China, the United States, the United Kingdom, Italy, Spain, Germany, Japan, and Brazil. Beyond hardware, the firm is a prominent developer and provider of artificial intelligence (AI) software solutions. These AI offerings include a suite of AI-generated content (AIGC) creator tools, such as Moyin Workshop for AI voiceover assistance, Weta365 for AI video generation and virtual live streaming, DupDub for AI voiceovers, and AI-powered written content generation solutions marketed under the names Mozhuan Writing and Qi Miao Wen. Furthermore, Mobvoi develops AI enterprise solutions, delivering intelligent, humanized AI voice interaction and advanced customer service capabilities to a broad spectrum of industries, including automotive, finance, technology, media, telecom, healthcare, and retail. The company also supports the open-source community with WeNet, an end-to-end voice recognition tool. Other operations include software development and the procurement of raw materials. Mobvoi Inc. was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
